ios.desc:
Track recovery with ECG-derived HRV from Aidlab. Pair the app with a compatible Aidlab chest-worn sensor to measure ECG, heart rate variability, respiration, skin temperature, sleep, and workouts, then follow how your body responds to training, stress, and rest.

Aidlab is built for people who want more than a generic activity tracker. Use your phone for basic activity tracking, or add Aidlab hardware when you want cleaner physiological signals from the chest.


FEATURES

• ECG-Derived HRV & Recovery: Measure HRV from ECG-based beat-to-beat intervals and track recovery trends after workouts, poor sleep, stress, and high daily load.

• ECG Recordings: Review your ECG recordings alongside heart rate and recording time to see the signal behind your HRV and recovery trends.

• Heart & Respiration Monitoring: With a compatible Aidlab Chest Strap, track heart rate, HRV, breathing pattern, respiration rate, and skin temperature in one place.

• Workout & Recovery Context: Analyze workouts alongside physiological signals to understand how your body reacts to effort and how quickly it returns to baseline.

• Sleep & Daily Trends: Follow sleep, recovery, and activity trends over time instead of relying on a single isolated number.

• Activity Timeline: Visualize your day on a clear timeline and see how movement, rest, and routines connect.

• Automatic Bodyweight Workout Tracking: With a compatible Aidlab Chest Strap, automatically recognize exercises such as running, push-ups, burpees, rope jumps, and stair climbing.


COMPATIBILITY

The Aidlab app is compatible with Aidmed One, Pulsoximeter, and Aidlab Chest Strap. Whether you train regularly, track recovery, or want deeper insight into your physiology, synchronize your device with Aidlab to understand your body with chest-based signals. Learn more at aidlab.com.


APPLE HEALTH

Aidlab integrates with Apple's Health app to keep selected activity and workout data connected with your broader health record. Use Apple Health as your hub, and Aidlab as the chest-based layer for ECG, HRV, respiration, and recovery insights.


FEEDBACK

We highly value your feedback. Send us your suggestions, compliments, or concerns to help us improve our app and services. Reach us at contact@aidlab.com.


PRIVACY

Your data is securely collected and stored in the cloud. You can delete your account at any time. When you do, access is revoked and direct identifiers in the account record are removed or replaced. Some de-identified records

quotes.text:
Hello!

I would like to share the alternative to the great Moves app (RIP). Lately, I've been tinkering on a similar app, also used for building daily dairy based on activity tracking. It does not have cycling/running detection yet, but maybe someone could find of interest: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/aidlab/id1123339447?mt=8

Features:

• 24/7 activity and biosignal monitoring through iPhone's sensors and (optionally) compatible Aidlab Chest Strap.

• Automatic Tracking: Records daily walking.

• Places: Recognizes places in your daily life.

• Storyline: Visualizes your day in an easy-to-read timeline.

• Motivational notifications.

Disclaimer:

* No ads.

* iOS only.

* It's free.

* It drains the battery a bit.

* Can be unstable for iOS 10.x and iPhone 5.

* All location/activity data are stored locally only.

Kuba from Aidlab

Hey HN!

We’re a team of engineers and product people who also happen to be lifelogging junkies.

We started Aidlab with the goal of making an app for tracking all-day activity accessible anywhere/anytime, and building the greatest on-demand experience without the need for expensive equipment.

With just the GPS and accelerometer on your phone, it:

- Recognizes places and records your data to illustrate an accurate portrait of your activity.

- Visualize your day in an easy-to-read timeline.

- Create daily, weekly, monthly and yearly summary.

- "Smart Notifications" feature will keep you aware and motivated.

- No external/physical trackers required.

Link: https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/aidlab/id1123339447

Disclaimer: all location/activity data are stored locally only (but everything is exportable). Account is not required.

If you have any questions let me know, and we’d love to hear your feedback!

Jacob.
